# BGU thesis-template assets

This directory contains two assets adapted from **BGU Thesis Template (New
Version 2022)** by Ilan Git:

- `bgu.png`
- `unsrtnat_adjusted_for_bgu_thesis.bst`

Source: https://www.overleaf.com/latex/templates/bgu-thesis-template-new-version-2022/xkvgwkkdtrpz

The source template is published on Overleaf under the Creative Commons
Attribution 4.0 International license (CC BY 4.0):
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The thesis wrapper and `styles/bgu-thesis.tex` in this repository adapt the
template's document structure, title pages, bilingual back matter, page style,
and spacing while keeping the scientific manuscript shared with the article
wrapper.
